import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try (Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
             PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            long w = scanner.nextLong();
            long m = scanner.nextLong();
            
            if (canWeigh(w, m)) {
                out.println("YES");
            } else {
                out.println("NO");
            }
        }
    }
    
    private static boolean canWeigh(long w, long m) {
        // We need to check if we can represent m as a sum of terms of the form ±w^i
        // where each coefficient is -1, 0, or 1 (left pan, not used, right pan)
        
        while (m > 0) {
            long remainder = m % w;
            
            // The remainder should be 0, 1, or w-1 (which corresponds to -1 in balanced representation)
            if (remainder == 0 || remainder == 1) {
                m = m / w;
            } else if (remainder == w - 1) {
                // This means we put a weight on the same side as the item (effectively adding 1 to the next higher power)
                m = m / w + 1;
            } else {
                // Cannot represent with balanced ternary-like system
                return false;
            }
        }
        
        return true;
    }
}
